notes.text: In the assembly accounts, Chutzpit was told to stop interpreting. Tosafot on Bekhorot names him among the Ten Martyrs. The pig occurs in Kiddushin and the tongue lying in refuse occurs in Chullin. The named martyr recension gives 180 interpretations alongside Heilprin’s 170. The year 2216 remains the printed label here, with the matching digital Almanac paragraph at 2217:2.
